name: management-ai
description: Management AI: agente AI ibrido (RAG + pandas agent) per la gestione di un club di calcio

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm run setup:python
scripts.setup:python: cd data_agent && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n chroma,agent,backend,frontend -c magenta,green,blue,yellow "npm run chroma" "npm run agent" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:agent
